captions.detailed: An Eastern Orthodox onion-dome bell tower featuring a tall, cylindrical masonry shaft in beige with darker grey circular base and trim rings. The upper belfry section consists of four vertical support pillars enclosing a bronze-colored bell hung from a horizontal beam. Above the belfry sits a golden-yellow onion dome topped with a thin spire and a small cross. The bell is mounted on a horizontal headstock beam via a revolute joint, allowing it to swing back and forth.
captions.instruction: Generate an Eastern Orthodox onion-dome bell tower featuring a beige cylindrical shaft, a belfry with four support pillars, and a golden onion dome on top. Inside the belfry, include a bronze bell that can swing about a horizontal axis via a revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the tower's main shaft using a series of stacked Cylinder primitives, adding dark grey base and trim rings. Model the belfry using four smaller cylinders arranged radially around a central opening, capped by a circular roof. Create the onion dome by lofting or revolving a curved profile, and top it with a thin cylinder spire and box-based cross. Model the bell with a flared cylinder shape, hanging it from a horizontal support beam in the belfry with a revolute joint defined along the Y-axis.
